comparison.objective: Candidate breaks four HELICOIL tangs and recovers them; record flush-cuts a PCB lead and deposits its offcut.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve bimanual controlled separation and debris handling. Candidate stabilizes a coaxial mandrel for hammer impact, then searches for loose tangs; record positions and closes nippers while the other hand directly restrains the offcut.
comparison.success_condition: Both demand successful separation plus contained debris. Candidate additionally requires four contact-loaded notch fractures and retained inserts without shell/coil damage; record requires a flush cut, no unheld flight beyond 10 cm, and offcut released in a cup. Candidate fracture, damage, and retention tolerances are not numeric.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record, but it tests shear cutting with proactive offcut capture; the candidate centrally tests impulse-controlled notch fracture through a recessed mandrel, withdrawal without coil displacement, and post-release fragment recovery.
